summary: Iteration 7: Phase 3 Scan-to-Spin end-to-end validated. Backend: expanded pytest suite from 42 -> 48 tests. New TestScanToSpinPhase3 class (6 tests) covers spin persistence, fraud-proof redeem (valid -> already_redeemed -> invalid), dashboard delta after spin+redeem, PNG QR data URI (verified magic bytes + playUrl='https://x.app/spin?space=Table%20Tent'), segments verification pulling live ledger (codesIssued/codesRedeemed/redemptionRate/revenue match dashboard; NOT the old 214/137), and persistence across `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`. Ran 45 tests serially (excluding TestVideoCritic which requires /tmp/clip.mp4 setup — validated in iter 6 and not part of Phase 3 scope): 45/45 PASSED in 20.9s. Frontend: (1) public /spin?space=Table%20Tent at 430x850 renders spin-play, click play-spin-btn -> spin-won appears with won-code='ST-TDEKPK' + copy-code-btn + expiry '2026-08-01'. (2) admin nav-maximizer: qr-generator with 'Counter Test' -> qr-image (data:image/png;base64,...) + open-play-link href=/spin?space=Counter%20Test. (3) redeem-station: clicked spin-btn -> issued HV-NSFYDZ -> typed into redeem-code-input with $42.5 -> 'Valid — Free Sub (BOGO) applied' (green). Same code again -> 'Rejected (already_redeemed) — Already redeemed on 2026-07-18 — one use only.' (red). NOPE-000000 -> 'Rejected (invalid) — Code not found — this coupon was never issued by OmniLocal #1.' (red). (4) Live ledger showed issued=58 redeemed=39 with 6 ledger-row-* entries. (5) Regression: nav-overview/executioner/maximizer/content all navigate cleanly, 4 game-* buttons, 3 guest-* options, drip-campaign, CSV import (load+import produced 12 imported/3 new queued), send-welcome-0 present, rfmd-table renders. Zero console errors across all runs, light theme intact.
action_items: OPTIONAL: /api/maximizer/redeem responds 200 with ok:false for all fraud rejections (invalid/already_redeemed/expired). Semantically these are client-side validation failures — using 200 makes the frontend contract simple (always read body.ok), but a stricter REST API would return 409 for already_redeemed and 404 for invalid.

OPTIONAL: /api/maximizer/spin/qr constructs playUrl by concatenating base + '/spin?space=...'. If a caller passes a base with a trailing slash it's stripped (good), but a base without a scheme (e.g. 'x.app') would produce 'x.app/spin?...' — no validation of URL scheme. Not exploitable but worth a Pydantic HttpUrl constraint.
OPTIONAL: server.py is now ~1700+ lines with Phase 0/1A/1B/3 all layered on. Very overdue to split into routers/services/models before Phase 2.
critical_code_review_comments: spin() in server.py uses random.Random() with no seed — non-deterministic and untestable in isolation. Consider injecting the RNG for pytest.

_seed_redemptions runs on startup via a state 'redemptions_seeded' guard (assumed) — verify the seed only runs once and does not duplicate on backend restart. The Phase 3 persistence test showed codesIssued went from 46 -> ~58 after several spins, which is consistent with a one-time seed, but there is no explicit guard visible in the snippet we reviewed.

maximizer_redeem uses datetime.fromisoformat on doc['expiresAt']; if a legacy row lacks the field this raises — the code guards with .get('expiresAt') but the subsequent > comparison on a None result would crash. The `if doc.get('expiresAt') and now > ...` short-circuits correctly, but a malformed ISO string would still raise ValueError.

The QR endpoint /api/maximizer/spin/qr accepts arbitrary `base` query without any allowlist — an attacker could pass base='https://evil.com' and get a QR that looks like it came from your app but leads elsewhere. In production, gate `base` to the deployment's own origin or drop the parameter entirely.

_unique_code has a fallback that appends uuid.uuid4().hex[:8] after 12 collision attempts — this technically produces a code that includes lowercase hex chars (e.g. HV-3a4f2b1c), breaking the CODE_ALPHABET assumption used by the CSV reconciliation logic. Cross-alphabet codes would appear valid via redemption but fail reconcile_csv's tier lookup.

Frontend Maximizer.js is now ~390 lines with 5 different modules in one component (games, QR, redeem, spin, drip, CSV, welcome, RFMD, ledger, Codes). Should be split into sub-components under sections/maximizer/*.
SpinPlay.js does not handle the API failure case — `await spin(...)` has no try/catch and no error UI, so a network failure leaves the user stuck on 'Good luck…' forever.

success_rate.backend: 100% (45/45 excl. Phase 1B video critic, validated in iter 6)

seed_data_creation: Redemptions ledger grew by ~10 codes during testing (2 from public /spin, 2+ from admin spin-btn clicks, 6 from Phase 3 pytest). Codes DB schema is stable; starter seed of 46 rows remains. All other demo defaults restored via TestPersistenceAcrossRestart's teardown (codes length=8, executioner reset, calendar reset, brand voice default, connections default).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests: `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v -n 0` runs 48 tests including Phase 1B video critic (~40s) and Phase 3 (6 tests, ~5s). The Phase 3 TestScanToSpinPhase3 class includes a `test_persistence_across_restart` that does `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` and waits for it to come back — allow ~15s for that. The /spin route is `{REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/spin?space=...` — this is a react-router page rendered from src/sections/SpinPlay.js, NOT part of the App sidebar. The admin redeem test reads the just-issued couponCode from spin-result via `document.querySelector('[data-testid="spin-result"] .mono')`.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in Phase 3. All anti-fraud guarantees hold end-to-end: (1) spin issues a persisted document to db.redemptions with status='issued' + unique code + 14-day expiry; (2) redeem does a Mongo find + validates status/expiry + atomically updates to 'redeemed'; (3) duplicate redeem correctly returns ok:false status='already_redeemed'; (4) bogus code returns ok:false status='invalid'; (5) dashboard is a live aggregation of the ledger — no hardcoded numbers; (6) data survives supervisorctl restart backend (verified via test_persistence_across_restart). The /spin public page issues real codes into the same ledger that the admin redeem station validates. QR data URI is real PNG (verified via magic bytes b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n').
